Name: Sam - Outfit and eye color choices
Author: PecuniamArt
Description:
Several Options for Sam! He now has a goatee and no mullet. Originally Sam had a green eyed sprite and blue eyed portrait.
His sprite and portrait now have eye color choices that match, choose from green eyed Sam or blue eyed Sam.

Each download Includes two shirt color options, a funky green and purple, or a cleaned up vanilla version

If you have suggestions for new versions of characters or animals, please feel free to leave a comment in the Posts section
